decisions.reason: This skin and hair supplement fits the firm's pharmacy-based consumer-health portfolio and, having remained in the range for several years, is likely to stay unless the category underperforms.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a narrower niche product, but it still supports the firm's portfolio-broadening strategy and immune-health demand gives it a reasonable case to remain listed.
The OTC migraine triptan is closer to the firm's pharmaceutical strengths and pharmacy customer base than the dropped noncore launches, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
